entries.zh: 直言不讳，说话毫无隐瞒；为人死心眼、直来直去（「死直」谓极直、不拐弯）。
entries.en: to speak the truth plainly, concealing nothing; blunt and outspoken.
entries.notes: M 栏两处调符污损难辨（T99）；字、音、义三者相合，释义可定，按低置信登记。

entries.zh: 嘴快，有话藏不住、脱口而出。
entries.en: to be quick-tongued, to blurt out whatever one is thinking.
entries.notes: 西语词头仅「hablar todos dicen」，语义不全，释义据汉字「口快」与音写定。

entries.zh: 开口说话，说出一句话；发言、出言。
entries.en: to speak, to open one's mouth; to utter a word.

entries.zh: 说些消遣打趣的话，闲谈逗趣。
entries.en: to say words in jest, to banter, to make talk for pastime.
entries.notes: 汉字栏有疑（閉/閘），音 eng-chuy 与「應嘴」一类语素相合，义从西语 pasatiempo（消遣）。

entries.zh: 多话，絮絮说出些讹误不实之言。
entries.en: to talk much, saying wrong or unfounded things; erroneous talk.
entries.notes: 西语「conuienden」疑为 conuierten/convienen 之讹，词头后半语义不完整。

entries.zh: 说话的语气、口气；（两人）和和气气地交谈。
entries.en: tone of voice, manner of speaking; to talk together amicably.

entries.zh: 接着前面的话说，照原话讲下去。
entries.en: to speak following on from what came before; to go on from the earlier words.

entries.zh: 东一句西一句地乱说，语无伦次（字面作「狗朝着风吠」）。
entries.en: to talk here and there at random, all jumbled together.
entries.notes: 首字有疑（哮/呼），取「哮」之吠义方与西语 rebolvo（杂乱）相合。

entries.zh: 说得不一样，说法有出入（「争差」即差异）。
entries.en: to speak differently from what was said before; to give a divergent account.

entries.zh: 说话（原稿并录两式「咀争走」「咀走争」，末字「走」义未详）。
entries.en: to speak (two word-order variants are recorded; the sense of the final element is unresolved).
entries.notes: 西语仅作「hablar.」，材料不足以定其别义，且第二式为倒序重录。

entries.zh: 先开口，起话头（「話頭」指话的开端）。
entries.en: to speak first; to open the conversation, to start the talk.

entries.zh: 谈笑，以闲谈说笑消遣。
entries.en: to chat and joke, to talk for amusement.

entries.zh: 交谈，对话。
entries.en: to converse, to talk with one another.
entries.notes: 「處講話」非固定成语，音 te-cong-oa，按「讲话、交谈」解，与西语 conversar 相应。

entries.zh: 说得有条有理、层次分明。
entries.en: to speak in an orderly, well-arranged manner; methodically.
entries.notes: 汉字作「條陳」而末字对音作 tit（合「直」不合「陳」），该字调符又污损（T99），故低置信。

entries.zh: 泛泛而谈，笼统地说；众人通说之言。
entries.en: to speak in general terms, to speak broadly.

entries.zh: 言语不通，说的不是同一种话。
entries.en: to speak without agreeing; to speak different languages.
entries.notes: M 栏与下条几乎同形，疑重录讹误，释义据 L（sin conuenir）+H 定。

entries.zh: 说同一种语言，口音相通。
entries.en: to speak the same language.
entries.notes: 同前条，M 栏疑讹，释义据 L（misma lengua）+H 定。

entries.zh: 南腔北调混着说，掺杂两种方言。
entries.en: to speak two languages or dialects, mixing northern and southern speech.
entries.notes: 末字对音 gue 近「話」（oē/uē）而汉字作「加」，字音不尽合。

entries.zh: （对熟人）仗着交情说话随便、不拘礼。
entries.en: to speak with a friend on familiar terms, presuming on one's acquaintance.

entries.zh: 话太多，多嘴。
entries.en: to talk too much, to be wordy.
entries.notes: 汉字有疑（恰/洽），「恰」作 khah（较）解方与音 ca 及「多」相合。

entries.zh: 胡言乱语，说话颠三倒四。
entries.en: to talk wildly, to rave; to speak incoherently.
entries.notes: 「如魯」非经见组合，义主要依西语 desvariando（胡言）推定。

entries.zh: 私下与人单独说话，说悄悄话。
entries.en: to speak privately with someone, alone; to whisper together.
entries.notes: 西语词头末尾残缺（con do[残]），仅「私語」与音写可据。
